Cc: support@novaloop.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended trial + promotional top-up for NovaLoop pilot

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding — the Redwood runtime has been smooth and the team is excited about the latency profile. We started our 30-day pilot on June 21 and have been running live traffic against the recommendation endpoint. Usage spiked last week as we ramped to a 50k DAU test cohort.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend our trial window by 30 days (current expiry 2027-07-20)? We need the extra time to complete the cohort run and collect quality signals.
- Would Redwood consider a one-time promotional top-up (200k tokens / equivalent credit) to help us finish the pilot? We can make it conditional on a short MOU and a mutual action plan (deliverables: model latency report, quality eval, joint case study).

Attached a small usage export (pilot_usage_report.csv) and a draft SOW so you can see scope. We’re a seed-stage fintech, raising a small bridge, so any runway extension helps us demonstrate product-market fit.

Appreciate a quick note on feasibility — we need to coordinate internally with our finance team if there’s paperwork.

Warmly,
Alex Chen
Co-founder, NovaLoop Labs
alex@novaloop.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

- Any objections on the case study ask?
